forum.content_text:
I'm trying to install the ST-Link USB Drivers following the instructions [here](https://dev.st.com/stm32cube-docs/stm32cubeide-vscode/latest/en/docs/markup/getting_started/installation.html). However, the STM32Cube Resources section does not include ST-Link USB Drivers.

![CTapp1_0-1778344416679.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/b926d0dc-e632-a5d9-0e9e-e7caf4ab3927.png "CTapp1_0-1778344416679.png")

I'm running the latest versions on VS Code and STM32CodeIDE extension.
